pending_commit.commit_message: network_WiFi_APSupportedRates: filter out null-data frames These are mainly used to notify transitions into and out of power-save mode. According to at least one vendor, these are intentionally at lower rates for reliability. They don't contribute much to airtime, so we should just exclude them from consideration in this test. tast-tests: add timing info for histogram verification. Add timing info for histogram snapshot / verification as they take some seconds to complete. With the timing info, we have a better view in timing.json to understand how long does each test stage take. Also, we figured out that expecting no GPU error takes 5 seconds, which is too long. Changed it to poll histogram at most one seconds.
